### A Heavenly Relationship
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-apr-9.html
Passage: Colossians 4:2
Points:
- Scripture emphasizes prayer as an essential habit rather than a performance for others.
- God commands prayer because He desires an intimate, two-way relationship with His children.
- Like loving parents who cherish talking with their children, the Lord takes pleasure in hearing from us.
- Families can deepen their bond with God and one another by bringing their needs to Him daily.

### An Attitude of Genuine Thanksgiving
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-april-14-2017.html
Passage: Colossians 4:2-4
Points:
- Paul humbly asked others to pray for clarity in his preaching despite decades of ministry experience.
- A life of lasting spiritual influence is marked by contentment and genuine thanksgiving.
- Believers should refuse to allow difficult external circumstances to govern their inner attitudes.
- Christ provides the power to overcome bitterness and maintain a thankful, prayerful spirit.
